quote: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: In front of any sidewalk elevator or chute or within a space of five feet on each side of such sidewalk elevator or chute.

activation.condition: Vehicle stops, stands or parks in front of a sidewalk elevator or chute or within five feet on either side.

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park at the stated place unless a stated exception applies.

exceptions: Necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law
Directions of a traffic control device

timing.description: During the qualifying stop, stand or park.
